note: Tier 2. Ball Lightning (6/1; "Trample", "Haste", "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature.") came under A's control this turn (how is not stated: the position claims no spell cast this turn, only that it has not been controlled continuously since A's turn began, 302.6) and attacks anyway thanks to haste (702.10b). B blocks with Grizzly Bears (2/2). Under trample A assigns lethal damage, 2, to the Bears and the excess, 4, to B (702.19b). The Bears' 2 damage kills Ball Lightning (toughness 1) at the same time (510.2, 704.5g), so its end-step sacrifice never triggers. The record starts at the declare attackers step, A's declaration pending: an entry must answer the pending question (spec 4), and declare_attackers does not answer the priority of the precombat main phase, so the position is the boundary of the first decision (spec 2.4). The position is stipulated (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play: how Ball Lightning came under A's control this turn is not shown.
